owner_creation.analysis: The cp pointer is a non-owning cursor into cmdbuf, initially null and set to the array base by cmd_reset before editing.
owner_creation.invariant: Cursor validity depends on the static command owner.

aliases_escapes.analysis: Step/repaint helpers copy cp into raw np/save_cp/old_cp aliases and update through pointer arguments; none retains ownership of command bytes.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Cursor aliases do not keep old command text unchanged.

callback_targets.analysis: Character stepping updates cp-related raw cursor aliases before repaint invokes terminal output using borrowed printable representations.
callback_targets.invariant: Formatting calls require the command cursor to remain valid.

invalidation.analysis: Insertion/erasure and scrolling change which byte a saved address denotes; cmd_reset repositions cp without tracking outstanding borrowed cursor values.
invalidation.invariant: A stable address can still identify changed logical content.

mutation_commit.analysis: cp, byte contents, display column and offset change separately; same-array/NUL assumptions must remain true through the edit.
mutation_commit.invariant: Cursor publication requires coherent byte and column state.

release_pair.analysis: cp is never freed; moving it does not move or release cmdbuf, and copied cursor values must not be passed to free.
release_pair.invariant: A cursor is always a borrow, never an allocation base owner.

error_cleanup.analysis: Start/end checks constrain normal cp movement, but error returns carry no validated cursor generation after replacement or reentry.
error_cleanup.invariant: Error returns do not certify saved raw cursors.

signals_handoff.analysis: No exclusive Rust borrow guards the cp shared pointer across exported editor calls and asynchronous terminal activity.
signals_handoff.invariant: Cursor lifecycle remains a raw-core alias constraint.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.
